info.title: Nexa V6 Solver Integration API
info.description: Machine-readable Nexa V6 discovery, signed active-set feed, route detail, and execution-permit surface. Static discovery endpoints perform no database, RPC, timer, or transaction work.

get.description: LISTEN/NOTIFY-backed current-state stream with no replay and no polling. No Last-Event-ID sends current immediately; an older ID sends current immediately; an ID equal to current suppresses the initial event; an invalid ID is ignored and current is sent. Subsequent confirmed publications are always emitted.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Feed dataVersion used only to suppress an identical initial current-state event. No history is replayed.

SignedFeedPayload.description: Sole cryptographic authority: feedHash and feedSignature cover this complete unfiltered object.

dataVersion.description: Unsigned integer encoded as a base-10 string.

SignedFeed.description: signedPayload is the only signed authority. routeDetailTemplate and actionableRoutes are convenience metadata outside the cryptographic authority. Top-level routes/openRoutes are filterable convenience views and must not be substituted during verification. Actionable economics are estimates, not execution guarantees; Permit issuance performs fresh amount-bound repricing and authorization.

dataVersion.description: Unsigned integer encoded as a base-10 string.

routeDetailTemplate.description: Feed-level read-only navigation template. Replace {routeId} with a route.routeId. This field is not part of signedPayload and is not cryptographic authority.

actionableRoutes.description: Deterministic, evidence-backed convenience shortlist. Resolve routeId/quoteId against signedPayload.routes before use. Missing evidence excludes only this shortlist and never removes a canonical signed route.

ActionableRoute.description: Non-authoritative economic estimate for route selection. Verify the corresponding signed route and obtain an Execution Permit before execution.
